 New Mexico State vs. San Diego State Stat Insights
 Points
 Last year, the Aztecs put up 6.2 more points per game (78.2) than the Aggies allowed (72.0).
 San Diego State had a 17-5 record last season when scoring more than 72.0 points.
 New Mexico State had a 15-7 record last season when allowing fewer than 78.2 points.
 The Aggies' 75.1 points per game last year were just 4.1 more points than the 71.0 the Aztecs allowed.
 New Mexico State put together a 13-8 record last season in games it scored more than 71.0 points.
 San Diego State had a 16-4 record last season when its opponents scored fewer than 75.1 points.
 The Aztecs put up a total of 238 more points than their opponents last year (an average of 7.2 per game), and the Aggies outscored opponents by 100 points on the season (3.1 more per game).
 Shooting
 Last season, the Aztecs had a 47.4% shooting percentage from the field, which was 6.4% higher than the 41.0% of shots the Aggies' opponents made.
 San Diego State went 19-4 when it shot better than 41.0% from the field.
 The Aggies shot 42.8% from the field, 2.8% higher than the 40.0% the Aztecs' opponents shot last season.
 Last season, New Mexico State had an 11-10 record in games the team collectively shot better than 40.0% from the field.
 Watch this game on Fubo (Regional restrictions may apply) .
 Rebounding
 The Aztecs and the Aggies grabbed rebounds at nearly the same clip last season (32.7 and 34.5 boards per game, respectively).
 New Mexico State was 12-9 overall when they won the rebounding battle. San Diego State was 3-8 when they failed to control the glass.
 The Aztecs were the 129th-ranked rebounding team in college basketball. The Aggies finished 56th.
 The Aztecs averaged 9 offensive rebounds per game, 1.6 rebounds less than the Aggies.
 The Aggies were 11-10 overall when they won the battle on the offensive boards. The Aztecs were 11-7 when they lost the rebounding edge.
 The Aggies were the 56th-ranked offensive rebounding team in college basketball, while the Aztecs finished 192nd.
 Both teams thrived on the boards last season. San Diego State recorded an average rebounding margin of +1.8 rebounds per game. New Mexico State averaged a margin of +2.8 rebounds.
